panels.description: Speed: once a day at 05:17 UTC, in the arrow's direction (download) and back (upload). iperf3 for the LAN cables, Ookla to Wingo Lausanne for the WAN. Colour = share of the link's ceiling (10G / 10G / 1G): green from 80 %, red below 50 %; WAN download 60 / 30 %, upload 20 / 10 %. signal = ONU receive power, bars for XGS-PON (-28 dBm = receiver limit). A failed run keeps the previous result; "-" = no good result in 2 days. 1h ... 1m = bytes through the router port both ways over that window (1m = 30 d, the Prometheus retention; less right after a router reboot).

panels.title: Salt OLT -> minas-tirith (enp1s0f0, XGS-PON)
panels.description: All internet traffic. Includes the daily Ookla run at 05:17 UTC.

panels.title: Yggdrasil -> minas-tirith (ygg0)
panels.description: Overlay traffic: Jellyfin relay, Grafana and ntfy for remote devices (a remote stream shows as upload). Rides on the Salt link, so it is also counted there.

panels.title: minas-tirith -> imladris (enp1s0f1, 10G DAC)
panels.description: Includes the daily iperf3 spike at 05:17 UTC.
